name: Shimla

description.title: Shimla – The Queen of Hills
description.short: A charming hill station with colonial buildings, pine forests, and scenic views, known as the 'Queen of Hills.'
description.long: Shimla, the 'Queen of Hills,' is a charming hill station with colonial buildings, pine forests, and scenic views. The Ridge, Mall Road, and toy train rides add to its appeal. Cool weather and lively bazaars make Shimla a favorite for families, honeymooners, and travelers seeking mountain charm.
description.history: Shimla was the summer capital of British India and is known for its colonial architecture and hill station charm.
description.overview: A classic hill station where colonial heritage meets mountain beauty, offering timeless charm and scenic experiences.

name: Manali

description.title: Manali – The Adventure Paradise
description.short: Nestled in the Kullu Valley, a mix of adventure and beauty with snow-capped peaks and apple orchards.

With Solang Valley and Rohtang Pass nearby, Manali offers both thrills and relaxation, making it one of Himachal's most popular destinations.

name: Dharamshala

description.title: Dharamshala – The Spiritual Mountain Town

description.history: Dharamshala became the home of the Dalai Lama and the Tibetan government-in-exile, making it a center of Tibetan culture and spirituality.
